plain_language.what_did_we_find: Provisional: all 54 synthetic preparation tests pass. Independent probes also distinguish three valid resource-limit observations from baseline failures. The controls now preserve measurement failures and reject the delayed-exit timeout race found during review. No selected terms or checker outcomes exist.
plain_language.is_it_interesting: Yes. The repaired controls let the finite study report observed time or memory limits without treating a broken monitor, missing accounting or unexpected checker output as a scientific result. Synthetic controls alone do not establish that RSS measurement works on the actual launch host.
plain_language.does_it_require_more_work: Run and independently review a positive actual-host direct-supervisor preflight, commit exact manifests, and obtain construction approval. The observer runner, sealed corpus, positive-profile smoke and launch gates remain separate work.

closed_control_findings: One direct target and sole wait4 owner; bounded coordinator fallback; raw streams drained concurrently
Late process snapshots discarded; sample collection start/end, actual gaps and spawn/reap endpoints retained
Delayed normal exit after time threshold is REPAIR_PAUSE rather than false time-limit observation
Failed group signal, malformed wait4 accounting, monitor fault, cleanup failure and raw-accounting mutation cannot be accepted
wait_status decodes to the recorded exit; one valid delivered SIGKILL must follow the exact threshold or above-ceiling sample
Post-exit high-water disposition requires normal exit and exact checker output; unexpected output remains repair
All baseline limit dispositions are repair pauses
Construction checks exact committed manifest/review bindings before rendering and rechecks before each build/export
Control regression uses synthetic ACTIVE queue state and will remain valid after item closure
measurement_limits: Elapsed time is monotonic spawn-to-reap and includes startup/reaping overhead; cleanup/draining recorded separately
Sampled group RSS is non-atomic, misses transient peaks and can count shared pages repeatedly
OS child lifetime high-water includes startup/exit, uses bound host units and excludes descendant memory
Fast zero-sample completions may be valid with complete accounting/cleanup, but the whole interval remains explicitly uncovered
Polling limits are not instantaneous hard ceilings; a high-water overrun after normal exit is not claimed as enforced protection
